title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: patternelmnt
text:
pattern element
pattern element
(definition)
Definition:
A positive (negative)
pattern
element is a "partial wild card" presented as a subset of the
alphabet
Σ, with the symbols in the subset specifying which symbols of Σ are matched (mismatched) by the pattern element.
Note:
